title: moquiniastrum bolivianum

It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis, wounds, and other inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of ongoing research in the field of ethnopharmacology.
